extracted.intended_audience: CIA directorates and agency staff responsible for preparing the OMB Circular A-44 Management Review and Improvement Program report (e.g., Director of Planning, Programming, and Budgeting; Inspector General; Director of Finance; Director of Personnel)
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and submit an Agency report under OMB Circular A-44 describing management review and improvement plans and accomplishments; contributions must follow OMB-prescribed sections, formats, deadlines, and emphasize substantive impact on management effectiveness and cost reduction. The memo assigns responsibilities for sections and integration into an overall agency submission to OMB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow OMB Circular A-44 elements and annual reporting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Office of Management and Budget Circular A-44 (Revised) delineates the several elements of the government's management improvement and review program as well as certain annual reporting requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare the required reports in accordance with A-44; remember the objective is identification and achievement of improvement goals, not preparing an impressive report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit required sections and details by specified deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Each Directorate is requested to submit to the Director of Planning, Programming, and Budgeting by 15 August 1972 details of plans and accomplishments as outlined in Sections II, IV, V, III, VII and VIII of the attachment. The integrated Agency report is due at OMB by 1 September.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timely submission of the section-specific contributions to PPB is mandatory to allow integration into the Agency report to OMB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report only reasonably significant accomplishments and plans
rubrics_metrics.description: In preparing each contribution to the Agency report, care should be taken to report only those accomplishments and plans which are reasonably significant in terms of their impact on the achievement of some Agency management, operational, or cost reduction goal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid trivial or marginal items; prioritize items that materially affect agency goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure reported accomplishments bear up under scrutiny
rubrics_metrics.description: Reported accomplishments, of course, should bear up under scrutiny and future management improvement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include evidence or support so that claimed accomplishments can withstand review and validation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plans should reflect serious intentions
rubrics_metrics.description: Actions and plans should reflect serious intentions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not list aspirational or non-committal plans; demonstrate concrete steps and commitments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality and validity over quantity
rubrics_metrics.description: The quality and validity of reported items are more important than quantity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer fewer, well-documented, high-impact items rather than many low-value entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use specified sections to focus on management improvements (priority-setting, performance evaluation, goal-setting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections I, II and VI of this year's report [are] vehicles to focus attention on real improvements in our management procedures for establishing priorities, evaluating performance and setting goals, all with the aim of increasing our overall effectiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structure your contributions to highlight changes in procedures and systems that improve priority-setting, performance measurement, and goal-setting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measure accomplishments against prior Management Effectiveness and Cost Reduction Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: The Management Effectiveness and Cost Reduction Goals outlined in last year's report to OMB, Sections III and IV, [are] against which our actual accomplishments should be measured.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare current accomplishments to previously stated goals and show progress or shortfall relative to those benchmarks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare contributions in OMB-prescribed format
rubrics_metrics.description: To provide a common basis for preparation of an overall Agency report, it is essential that each Section be prepared in accordance with the format prescribed by OMB. Self-designed forms or formats will have to be returned by the Office of Planning, Programming, and Budgeting for resubmission in accordance with OMB instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit custom formats; follow the exact templates and formats in the A-44 attachment to avoid resubmission delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify priority agency-wide improvement projects in a covering memorandum
rubrics_metrics.description: In a covering memorandum any contributor may suggest priority improvement projects which require Agency-wide attention and action by the Executive Director-Comptroller in order to implement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a proposed improvement requires cross-directorate action, highlight it separately in a covering memo and explain required executive actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assign and document responsibility for specific report sections
rubrics_metrics.description: The Inspector General will be responsible for Section I. Section III will be prepared by the Director of Finance. (Section VIII should be submitted through the Director of Personnel.) The Director of Planning, Programming, and Budgeting is assigned the task of integrating these contributions into an overall agency report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure each section lists or reflects the responsible office/person, so accountability and integration responsibilities are clear.
